pages.text: Store at least two dragons in your Dragon Staff. Open the Dragon Book, choose to start the fight, and confirm. The fight takes 60 seconds. Released dragons do not participate. If the top scores are tied, the dragon registered first wins.

pages.title: Winner's Mark
pages.text: Each win permanently increases maximum health, attack damage, armor, and armor toughness by 2.5% per participant. A marked winner triples those grown stats when released. Storing it removes only the release bonus. Releasing it again does not stack the tripling or restore current health.

pages.title: Modifier Recipe
pages.text: Dragon Staff only; costs 1 ability slot. Requires any Ice and Fire dragon skull, one bucket of Hastur's Malice, and one piece each of fire, ice, and lightning dragon flesh.
